programmes.phase: Phase 2: Most valuable promotions / perfect offer
programmes.definition: Most valuable promotion = the offer that delivers the highest incremental contribution margin after discount, platform commission and marketing spend
programmes.research_goal: Try to know the MVP from existing restaurants. know from them by asking them the right questions, what is the best formula on delivery apps
programmes.benefit: the most optimzed marketing strategy for your brand on delivery platforms
programmes.market_context: only 3% of restaurants in france achieve this profit margin. 97% is out untapped market.

programmes.phase: Phase 3: Kitchen optimization / new brand creation
programmes.definition: optimze your operations and double your profit margin!
programmes.benefit: optimze your operations and double your profit margin!

metrics.definition: How the outlet is named, categorized, and tagged for platform search; cumulative rating and review sentiment
metrics.benefit: Makes the outlet matchable and ranks it higher in search
metrics.problem_solved: Invisibility — a great menu that never surfaces generates zero orders
metrics.key_metric: Search rank for core keyword; average star rating; review response rate
metrics.healthy_benchmark: 4.5★+; top 10 rank for concept term; 100% reviews answered within 24h
metrics.red_flag: <4.0★; outside top 20 for own concept keyword; unanswered negative reviews
metrics.recommended_action: Re-tag concept to match actual search terms customers use; run a review-recovery push; answer every review within 24h
metrics.data_needed: Search rank position per keyword; star rating history; review text/sentiment; competitor listings for same keyword
metrics.outcome_delivered: Ranked visibility diagnosis + prioritized list of keyword/tag/review fixes
metrics.automation: Platform seller dashboard exports; sentiment tagging via NLP/GPT; no native cross-platform rank tracker — usually manual/API pull

metrics.definition: Visual and text presentation of each item
metrics.benefit: Converts a viewed listing into a placed order
metrics.problem_solved: Low click-to-order conversion
metrics.key_metric: % items with professional photos; item click-to-order rate
metrics.healthy_benchmark: 90–100% items photographed; ~15–20% of viewers order after clicking
metrics.red_flag: <70% photographed; items with views but zero orders
metrics.recommended_action: Reshoot underperforming items; rewrite descriptions to lead with flavor/texture, under 20 words
metrics.data_needed: Per-item view count, click count, order count from seller dashboard; current photo/description audit
metrics.outcome_delivered: List of items missing photos + ranked list of lowest-converting listings to fix first
metrics.automation: Uber Eats Manager / Deliveroo Restaurant Hub analytics export; spreadsheet flag for items below CTR threshold

metrics.definition: % of accepted orders cancelled by kitchen, customer, or platform
metrics.problem_solved: Order leakage after the sale
metrics.recommended_action: Real-time inventory sync; 86 unavailable items immediately
metrics.data_needed: Order-level cancel log with reason code and item ID
metrics.outcome_delivered: Cancel rate % + top cancel reasons + top offending SKUs
metrics.automation: POS/inventory sync tool (Deliverect, Otter) to auto-86 items; platform dashboard cancel report export

metrics.definition: Actual prep time vs. quoted platform window
metrics.benefit: Keeps orders on-time, avoids penalty flags
metrics.problem_solved: Late orders trigger cancellations + ranking penalty
metrics.recommended_action: Re-time quoted prep windows realistically; add a kitchen display system
metrics.data_needed: Timestamp log: order accepted → order marked ready, per order
metrics.outcome_delivered: % orders within window + list of items/times causing overruns
metrics.automation: Kitchen display system (KDS) with built-in timing reports — e.g. Deliverect KDS, Otter

metrics.definition: Time from order-ready to customer receipt
metrics.problem_solved: Slow delivery erodes trust even if kitchen was fast
metrics.key_metric: Avg. delivery time vs. platform city average
metrics.recommended_action: Flag to platform account manager; adjust delivery radius
metrics.data_needed: Timestamp: order ready → delivered; platform city benchmark
metrics.outcome_delivered: Delivery time variance vs. city average + flag to raise with platform
metrics.automation: Platform performance dashboard (Uber Eats / Deliveroo — provided directly, not third-party)

metrics.definition: % of operating hours the menu is actually live/orderable
metrics.benefit: Maximizes ordering window; keeps ranking algorithm favorable
metrics.problem_solved: Missed revenue during unexpected "closed" windows
metrics.data_needed: Log of online/offline status per hour vs. posted operating hours
metrics.outcome_delivered: Uptime % + list of unplanned downtime windows
metrics.automation: POS-to-platform integration (Deliverect, Otter) for automatic open/close sync

metrics.definition: $ value refunded per period, by reason and item or order
metrics.benefit: Identifies which SKUs/issues cost the most
metrics.problem_solved: Silent profit leakage tied to specific items
metrics.key_metric: Refund $ as % of revenue; refund count by item or order
metrics.recommended_action: Pull top 3 refunded items; fix packaging/recipe for those specifically
metrics.data_needed: Refund transaction log with item ID, $ amount, and reason
metrics.outcome_delivered: Refund % of revenue + ranked list of top refunded SKUs
metrics.automation: Platform payout/refund report export; pivot table for top offenders

metrics.definition: Items missing from otherwise-correct orders
metrics.benefit: Prevents disproportionate damage from small errors
metrics.problem_solved: A missing $2 side can cause a full refund + bad review
metrics.recommended_action: Packing checklist with item-count verification at hand-off
metrics.outcome_delivered: Forgotten-item rate + which stations/times it clusters around
metrics.automation: None standard — manual packing checklist log, or QR/barcode scan-out if available

metrics.definition: Commission + VAT + pay-to-play costs (highlighted ads, boosted placement) — up to ~30% plus marketing spend
metrics.benefit: Reveals true net payout per order, not gross sale
metrics.problem_solved: Hidden margin loss — busy but unprofitable
metrics.key_metric: Net payout as % of gross order value
metrics.healthy_benchmark: Retain >70% of order value after platform cut
metrics.recommended_action: Understand their revenue after platform fees
metrics.data_needed: Gross order value vs. net payout per order from platform statement; ad/boost spend log
metrics.outcome_delivered: True net retention % after all platform costs
metrics.automation: Platform payout statement export; reconciliation spreadsheet comparing gross vs. net

metrics.definition: Ingredient + packaging cost per item, tracked individually
metrics.benefit: Sets the real cost floor per item, not an averaged guess
metrics.problem_solved: Mispriced items eating margin unnoticed
metrics.healthy_benchmark: Food cost 28–32%; packaging <5% of item price
metrics.recommended_action: Re-cost recipes; renegotiate packaging supplier; portion-control retraining
metrics.data_needed: Recipe costing sheet (ingredient quantities × supplier price); packaging unit cost
metrics.outcome_delivered: Per-item food cost % + variance vs. theoretical
metrics.automation: Recipe costing module (e.g. KitchenIQ); inventory management system for actual vs. theoretical usage

metrics.definition: The right menu SKU pricing based on platform fees and COGS
metrics.benefit: Ensures each item's platform price already covers commission, VAT, and food cost before any order is taken
metrics.problem_solved: Underpriced items that look fine at COGS level but lose money once platform fees are deducted
metrics.key_metric: Price coverage ratio = Item price ÷ (COGS + platform fee + VAT)
metrics.red_flag: Ratio < 1.15 (item barely covers cost after fees)
metrics.recommended_action: Reprice SKU using C.1 fee % and C.2 COGS as direct inputs, not gut-feel markup
metrics.data_needed: C.1 fee %, C.2 COGS per item, target margin
metrics.outcome_delivered: Recommended sell price per SKU that guarantees margin after fees
metrics.automation: Pricing formula built into KitchenIQ: price = (COGS + target margin) ÷ (1 − platform fee %)

metrics.definition: Rent, base team wages, kitchen utilities/electricity — incurred regardless of volume
metrics.problem_solved: Utilization blind spot — not knowing the volume needed just to cover base costs
metrics.key_metric: Breakeven orders/day = fixed cost ÷ avg. contribution margin per order
metrics.red_flag: Actual volume at or below breakeven
metrics.recommended_action: Add a second virtual brand on the same kitchen to raise volume without raising fixed cost
metrics.data_needed: Monthly rent, payroll, utility bills; average contribution margin per order (from C.1–C.3)
metrics.automation: Spreadsheet formula (breakeven = fixed cost ÷ contribution margin); no standard off-the-shelf tool

metrics.definition: Classification of each item by margin and velocity
metrics.benefit: Flags what's worth keeping vs. cutting
metrics.problem_solved: Menu bloat diluting focus and prep complexity
metrics.recommended_action: Cut or re-engineer bottom-quadrant items every quarter
metrics.data_needed: Per-item sales volume and margin % over a defined period (e.g. 90 days)
metrics.automation: POS sales export + spreadsheet matrix formula; some POS systems (Square, Lightspeed) have built-in menu engineering reports

metrics.definition: Fixed-price bundles pairing a hero item with a high-margin side/drink
metrics.benefit: Lifts AOV, steers customers to high-margin items
metrics.problem_solved: Low-AOV orders that don't clear margin after commission/packaging
metrics.key_metric: Combo attach rate %; AOV lift vs. non-combo orders
metrics.recommended_action: Feature the combo as the default/first option on the listing
metrics.data_needed: Current AOV; item-level attach rates; item pairing frequency
metrics.outcome_delivered: Recommended combo pairings + attach rate target

metrics.definition: On-platform ad/boost spend and off-platform promo spend
metrics.benefit: Ties spend to orders that actually clear margin
metrics.problem_solved: Wasted acquisition spend that doesn't convert profitably
metrics.recommended_action: Pause underperforming boosted listings; reallocate spend to top D.1 "star" items only
metrics.data_needed: Ad spend by campaign/listing; incremental orders attributed; ROAS from platform ads manager
metrics.automation: Platform Ads Manager (Uber Eats Ads, Deliveroo Plus) built-in reporting

metrics.definition: Inventory of all active and historical offers
metrics.benefit: Understand what is already being used
metrics.problem_solved: Promotions are often launched without knowing their real profitability
metrics.red_flag: Promotion increases orders but reduces profit

metrics.definition: Calculates real economics after discount, platform fee, COGS and ad spend
metrics.benefit: Shows whether an offer actually makes money
metrics.problem_solved: Revenue uplift can hide margin destruction
metrics.data_needed: Price, COGS, commission, discount, ad spend
metrics.outcome_delivered: True profit generated by each offer

metrics.definition: Determines which mechanic to test: discount, bundle, free item, threshold offer, etc.
metrics.problem_solved: Same promotion type does not work for every brand
metrics.red_flag: One mechanic used repeatedly without evidence

metrics.definition: Determines which SKUs should be included
metrics.problem_solved: Low-margin products are often promoted
metrics.recommended_action: Shift promotion to higher-margin / strategic SKUs

metrics.definition: Combines hero items with profitable sides / drinks
metrics.problem_solved: Discounts often reduce price rather than increase basket value

metrics.definition: Finds the minimum discount required to create incremental demand
metrics.problem_solved: Operators give away more margin than necessary
metrics.red_flag: Higher discount adds little incremental volume

metrics.definition: Sets the right basket threshold for an offer
metrics.problem_solved: Promotion applied to orders that are too small

metrics.definition: Determines best day / hour for a promotion
metrics.benefit: Uses promotions when they create incremental demand
metrics.problem_solved: Promotions subsidize orders that would happen anyway
metrics.red_flag: High discount during naturally strong periods

metrics.definition: Determines how long and how often to run an offer
metrics.problem_solved: Always-on discounting trains customers to wait for offers

metrics.definition: Estimates orders caused by the promotion vs orders that would happen anyway
metrics.problem_solved: Promo revenue is mistaken for incremental revenue
metrics.red_flag: Large promo volume but little incremental lift

metrics.definition: Measures whether promoted products steal sales from more profitable products
metrics.problem_solved: One offer can hurt another SKU
metrics.red_flag: Promo SKU grows while total profit falls

metrics.definition: Connects paid visibility to actual profit
metrics.problem_solved: ROAS can look good while profit is negative

metrics.definition: Measures whether paid visibility and discounting together are profitable
metrics.problem_solved: Operators stack costs without measuring combined impact

metrics.definition: Scores each promotion based on incremental contribution margin
metrics.problem_solved: Operators lack a single decision metric
metrics.red_flag: High-volume promotion ranks low on profit

metrics.definition: Recommends the next offer to run
metrics.problem_solved: Data without action does not improve margin
metrics.red_flag: No measurable improvement after repeated tests

metrics.definition: Continuous experimentation loop
metrics.problem_solved: Promotion strategy stays static

metrics.definition: Calculates the gap between current net profit and 17%
metrics.benefit: Connects promotions directly to business target
metrics.problem_solved: Operators optimize campaigns without knowing required margin uplift

metrics.definition: Tracks whether Phase 2 actions are moving the business toward 17%
metrics.problem_solved: Individual improvements may not translate into business profitability
